string.text: Artifact Visibility by Expand. Idea: SoC-style Artefacts (DLTX) by MaxSpringer.
Glow light, particles and "detectors find all artefacts" are chosen in the mod installer (reinstall the mod in Mod Organizer 2 to change them).

Keeps artefacts lying in the world visible without a detector. Off = the game hides them again a few seconds later, until a detector finds them (installer options for light, particles and detectors stay active). Applies immediately. Costs a tiny check per artefact every 2 seconds.
On every save load, writes one line to the game log (xray_*.log, tag [SoCArts]) showing which installer options are active. Only for bug reports.
